brief: UBS Prime Brokerage hedge fund flows for the session after midterm results track yesterday's risk-on bounce. Hyperscalers were the most-bought US segment (+1.1std, 100% long buying), reversing pre-earnings/midterm de-risking. Software & SaaS was also strongly bought (+1.6std, 93% long buying), concentrated in AI software names, extending September's net buying. Hardware (-0.4std) and Memory (-0.3std) stayed net sold, de-risked since May. Rate Cut Winners were bought +2.5std (73% long buying); Staples had been covered and long-bought through October on a priced Democratic win, leaving HFs positioned for the bounce. HF flows were muted in Power (-6.3% yesterday) and Neoclouds (-8.4%), implying the selloff came from elsewhere, potentially macro funds; Semis flows were muted because HFs had already de-risked in October to July lows. Materials saw the clearest profit-taking (-3.2std), led by Specialty Chemicals. In Europe, Ex-AI laggards led buying; High Momentum and Low Quality saw the strongest buying, mostly long buying not covering. Luxury and Consumer Discretionary saw heavy covering. High Quality and Energy kept unwinding as US/Iran priced toward resolution; UBS added EU Energy shorts. UBS Equity Strategy recommends buying Semis (buybacks, demand, cheap valuations, light positioning) and Hyperscalers (cloud revenue growth roughly tripled QoQ).
